name: In re Thurmon
how: §1182(1)(A): debtors who had stopped operating and sold the business before filing were not engaged in commercial or business activities, so not eligible for subchapter V

name: In re Ikalowych
how: §1182(1)(A) read broadly: an individual dealing with the debts of a former business was engaged in commercial or business activities, so eligible

name: In re Port Arthur Steam Energy, L.P.
how: §1182(1)(A): a former owner of a waste-heat power facility, still winding up and pursuing claims, was engaged in commercial or business activities; the debtor bears the burden of showing eligibility

name: In re RS Air, LLC (NetJets Aviation, Inc. v. RS Air, LLC)
court: Bankruptcy Appellate Panel of the Ninth Circuit
how: §1182(1)(A): no profit motive is needed to be engaged in commercial or business activities; the debtor bears the burden of proving subchapter V eligibility
